## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking, ungainly man with stooping shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders, along with a full, soft brown beard that he has worn since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew Cuthbert is an exceptionally quiet, hardworking, and shy man who deeply dislikes being among strangers or placing himself in unfamiliar social situations. He holds a particular dread of women, whom he suspects of secretly laughing at him, as well as a mortal fear of little girls. Despite his unobservant and reserved nature, he is remarkably patient, wise, and good-natured, proving to be a sympathetic listener who enjoys hearing talkative people speak. He possesses an indulgent disposition toward [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), whom he persistently wished to keep, listening to her with silent enjoyment and encouraging her with quiet warmth.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert was an extremely shy man who lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and spent decades wearing a full soft brown beard, avoiding almost all women except his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Due to his intense shyness, he rarely left his home, but he eventually traveled to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to pick up an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Instead, he discovered a young girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and finding himself surprisingly fond of her talkative nature during the ride, he gently urged [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they keep her. Over time, Matthew consistently supported [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), bringing her sweeties, secretly encouraging her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) after a quarrel, and convincing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to allow her to attend a local concert. Seeing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacked fashionable clothing, he overcame his deep shyness with female shopkeepers by arranging for Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to sew [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). Matthew offered warm encouragement for her schooling, felt immense pride when she tied for first place on the Island's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, and celebrated her commencement when she won the Avery Scholarship. Following a tender evening walk with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after her return home, Matthew collapsed and died suddenly from the shock of reading about a bank failure.

>

> "It’ll have to be done sooner or later, you know, for Marilla’s a dreadful determined woman—dreadful determined, Anne. Do it right off, I say, and have it over."

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are the best of friends, a connection that begins when Matthew brings her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and immediately advocates for keeping her despite Marilla's shock at receiving a girl instead of a boy. Throughout her upbringing, Matthew quietly supports [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), privately persuading her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her room and bringing her sweeties as gifts. He consistently acts as a gentle ally who encourages her happiness and inclusion in local events.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +17 more_

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/matthew-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is a trusted neighbor who keeps a close eye on the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) household and provides advice regarding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). She initially warns the family about the risks of adopting an orphan when she spots Matthew driving out of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), but later forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after a dramatic apology and provides [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with guidance on how to manage the girl's upbringing. She continues to interact with the family as a supportive neighbor, eventually making and buying a dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), +10 more_
